notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Added loadout point limit option to custom servers.
Added perk effect multiplier option to custom servers.
Added a test version of the PvE map.
You can use Shift+Ctrl+S to take out enemies.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1
Bug fixes
Fixed a bug that caused the MP5 to flicker.

notes.title: alpha 1.5.4 Update!
notes.content:
[b]A quick summary[/b]
Added the new weapon Type 89.
Added new maps.
Added balance adjustments.


Lowered overall recoil temporarily.
Made movement slower and slower.
Fixed footsteps and jumping sounds.
Changed the menu screen when playing.
Weakened the speed of running perk.
Made bullets (practically) infinite.
Some sound-related adjustments were made.
Added new weapon Type 89.
Added a new map.

Bug fixes
Fixed a bug where you could run backwards.
Fixed a bug that prevented the use of auto aim.
Fixed a bug that caused the game to reload when changing weapons during reloading and then returning them.
Fixed a bug where throwing a weapon would cause the weapon to hold in place.
Fixed a bug that caused the area to always shrink to the same position.
Fixed a bug that would disable sniper kills.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: alpha 1.4 Update!
notes.content:
alpha 1.4

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug in the result screen.
Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze the moment you entered a quick match and prevented all operations except for loading out the E key (ID:93)
Fixed a bug where area positions were not synchronized

Additions and Changes
Added the ability to watch games in Battrois mode.
Added spray function. (Default T key)
Auto Aim Park has been added.


Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: alpha 1.3 Update!!
notes.content:
alpha 1.3 Update!!

[b]A quick summary[/b]
Quick Match added.
We've localized it for English and Japanese.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36543566/f257f7711c858ae539f96ee3bea1ee9169cb3c18.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36543566/ce4b3c7a51a319b3ad90452d792c756efbc44292.png[/img]

Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that caused a jump sound when crouching.
Fixed a bug that prevented BOTs from taking area damage.
Fixed a bug that caused the room exit dialog to stick. (ID 86)

Additions and Changes
Loadout can now be changed when de-scamming.
Weapon changes can now be made quickly.
Shotguns can now be fired while reloading.
More FPS display options.
Can now watch a fight when dying in Batrois mode.
Added a quick match.
Increased the power of submachine guns and handguns
Added English and Japanese translation.

notes.title: alpha 1.1.1 update!
notes.content:
It's still in development!
I've been keeping you posted on Twitter and on Discord about the development progress!
https://discord.com/invite/saqPGJY
https://twitter.com/QUICAL_FPS

alpha 1.1.1

Bug Fixes
Fixed the number of rounds per shotgun shot to 9.
Invincibility cheat bug could probably and surely be fixed.
Fixed a bug where the player was not animated.
Fixed a bug where player angles were not synchronized.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from finishing in first place.
Fixed a bug where the UI was not showing up when entering a room.

Additions and Changes
We made the initial area smaller.
Increased area shrinkage speed.
Slowed default player speed
Weakened M32 grenade launcher and SMG
Replaced map

notes.title: pre alpha 1.1.0 Update!!
notes.content:
Want an alpha key? Free distribution on Discord! !
https://discord.gg/tQDkMtU


Bug fix
Fixed rock hit detection.
Fixed a bug where the number of players and the number of votes were visible on the loadout selection screen.
Fixed a bug where you could select a loadout that could not be selected in the loadout selection.
Fixed a bug where kills were not displayed. However, invincible transparent cheat bugs may have recurred.

Additional changes
Reduced the volume of BGM in the default state.
Added hit detection for trees.
Eliminating trees and rocks sinking into the house.
I tried to fix the bug that started while selecting the loadout, but it took a while d (ry time was going to take a long time, so I forcibly kicked it.
Made the damage area "good feeling".
The number of players has been changed.
Map2 and Map3 have been deleted.
Some mode names have been changed.
In order to prevent population divergence, the available regions have been changed only for Japan, the United States and Melbourne.

The park relationship has changed significantly.

Changed text for crouching speed park.
Weakened the squatting speed park magnification.
I borrowed the points consumed by the squatting speed park.
The running speed park magnification has been increased.
I borrowed the points consumed by the running speed park.
I waited for the points to be consumed in the jumping power increase park.
Increased reload speed perk multiplier.
Wait for the point of consumption of the reload speed increase park.
Increased the maximum health park magnification.
I borrowed the points consumed by the maximum health park.

Roughly apde summary for busy people
Fixed a bug where kills were not displayed.
Various parks have been strengthened.
Increased the cost of various parks.
Map2 and Map3 have been deleted.
